Recorded claim:
Bug 1901912 records that the broad bug 1851535 cleanup accidentally removed MessengerProfileMigrator XPCOM registration and broke the --migration command-line flag. A later fix restored registration; current mail/components/components.conf still registers the constructor. This is an umbrella-bug regression, not evidence that D211683 alone caused it. When deleting apparently dead components, check command-line and migration consumers that may instantiate a class indirectly by contract.

Provenance: 8339ec79e033668c720c4525e11e2a9d40baf411db5aa1d29584326214130c8d. Original evidence IDs: 8e64d68948b70af62b4acc6a96599e481b3c0f6a351db5ee21efa0e5c5ce907b, e7839e6d4ed3e0e91ed9ea5d7a160d124b995c66467596a6c9dd6f78a1fcf236.

title: Recorded lesson: Dead-code cleanup must preserve migration component registration
